sources.title: Monzo Help - Why there's a fee for cash deposits
Personal banking service quality – Great Britain | Ipsos

brands.evidence: A recurring frustration with Monzo in the UK is not knowing what’s happening when access to your money is interrupted.

client_claims.text: You can pay cash in at a Post Office or PayPoint, but deposits can carry a fee.
client_claims.note: Cash deposit fees are not covered by the facts.

client_claims.text: 82% of Monzo customers surveyed in Great Britain said they'd recommend it.
client_claims.note: Facts give an NPS of 76 but not this survey figure.

client_claims.text: Monzo ranked first for overall service quality in the independent Ipsos survey published in August 2026.
client_claims.note: Ipsos survey ranking is not covered by the facts.

client_claims.text: Financial Ombudsman cases describe customers losing access to accounts without a clear explanation, including one couple whose account closure disrupted a mortgage payment.
client_claims.note: Ombudsman cases are not covered by the facts.
